name: Anterior Tibialis Tendinopathy
definition: Overuse or degenerative disorder of the tibialis anterior tendon causing anterior ankle or medial midfoot pain, especially with dorsiflexion loading.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; ultrasound/MRI is used for persistent symptoms or suspected tear.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Marked weakness or suspected rupture requires specialist imaging/review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Overuse or degenerative disorder of the tibialis anterior tendon causing anterior ankle or medial midfoot pain, especially with dorsiflexion loading.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
